body:
Follow-up to `garment-optics` (its "contact resistance at crossings" next step). Two-layer resistor-network model of a conductive weave: contacts have no effect on an intact fabric, but with 20% of yarn segments broken a contact equal to one segment raises sheet resistance 22% and ten segments 2.3x. Stylised; contact values are a sweep, not measured. 7 tests pass; `python site/build.py` prints ok.
